# Marked

`marked.esm.js` is the unmodified browser ESM distribution from [Marked 18.1.3](https://www.npmjs.com/package/marked/v/18.1.3). The upstream license is included in this directory.

Koma calls only the lexer. `MarkdownSynopsis.ets` projects its tokens into ArkUI text spans. The adjacent declaration describes only the lexer interface used by that adapter.
